<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>S-T-I-K-S // Боевой модуль и Симулятор (bsim v2.4)</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body { background: #0b0d0c; color: #d6e5db; font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.35; padding: 8px; max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto; }
.box { background: #111613; border: 1px solid #6e2626; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.hdr { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #5c2828; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; gap: 6px; }
.hdr b { color: #ff9e9e; font-size: 12px; }
.grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
label { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: #a87f7f; margin-bottom: 2px; }
select, input { width: 100%; background: #080a09; color: #e6f2ea; border: 1px solid #4a1c1c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; }
select:disabled { opacity: 0.65; color: #9ab0a2; }
.btn { background: #1b221e; color: #d6e5db; border: 1px solid #6e2626; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 8px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; user-select: none; }
.btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
.btn:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.btn-primary { background: #3b1515; border-color: #8f2d2d; color: #f5d6d6; font-weight: bold; }
.btn-mana { background: #14263b; border-color: #2d6a8f; color: #b8dcff; font-weight: bold; }
.btn-ok { background: #153322; border-color: #2e7d4f; color: #b6f5cf; font-weight: bold; }
.btn-dar { background: #221633; border-color: #6b3fa0; color: #e2caff; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; }
.btn-sm { padding: 3px 6px; font-size: 10px; width: auto; }
.chip-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin: 6px 0; }
.chip-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #0b0e0c; border: 1px solid #3d1c1c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 11px; gap: 6px; }
.passive-badge { background: #1a1810; border: 1px solid #8c7326; color: #f2dc88; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 7px; font-size: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; transition: all 0.25s; }
.passive-badge.flash { background: #4a3c12; border-color: #ffd54f; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd54f; color: #fff; }
.passive-badge.empty { opacity: 0.45; border-color: #4a422b; color: #8c8265; }
#combat-stage { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 240px; border: 1px solid #8f2d2d; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #090b0a; margin-bottom: 8px; }
#stage-bg-svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 1; }
.dist-pill { position: absolute; top: 5px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 4; background: rgba(10,12,11,0.9); border: 1px solid #6e2626; color: #e6c86e; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.col-fighters { position: absolute; top: 26px; bottom: 6px; z-index: 2; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; }
.enemy-lane { position: relative; height: 31px; width: 100%; }
.enemy-lane .mini-unit { position: absolute; transition: right 0.55s ease, transform 0.25s ease, opacity 0.35s ease; }
.mini-unit { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: rgba(10,13,12,0.88); border: 1px solid #5c2828; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 4px; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
.mini-unit.ally { border-color: #2e7d4f; }
.mini-unit.enemy { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
.mini-unit.dead { opacity: 0.32; filter: grayscale(1); border-color: #333; }
.mini-unit.active-turn { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff9e9e; border-color: #ff9e9e; z-index: 4; }
.mini-unit.stun { border-color: #facc15; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #facc15; }
.mini-unit.debuff { border-color: #38bdf8; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #38bdf8; }
.stun-tag { position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #3b2f08; border: 1px solid #facc15; color: #ffe66d; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: nowrap; z-index: 6; }
.debuff-tag { position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: #0c2a3d; border: 1px solid #38bdf8; color: #bae6fd; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 3px; white-space: nowrap; z-index: 6; }
.dist-mini { font-size: 8px; color: #e6c86e; margin-left: 2px; }
.mini-pic { width: 22px; height: 25px; border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; flex: 0 0 auto; background: #140e0e; }
.mini-pic img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.mini-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.mini-lbl { font-size: 9px; color: #eef7f1; max-width: 74px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.mini-bar { width: 56px; height: 3px; background: #241212; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 2px; }
.mini-fill { height: 100%; background: #e53935; transition: width 0.25s ease; }
.mini-fill.ally { background: #4caf50; }
.float-layer { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 5; pointer-events: none; }
.float-pop { position: absolute; font-weight: bold; font-size: 10px; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000, 0 0 4px #000; animation: popBack 1.5s ease-out forwards; white-space: nowrap; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; }
.float-dmg { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.65); }
.float-crit { color: #ff3b3b; font-size: 11px; background: rgba(35,5,5,0.85); border: 1px solid #8f2d2d; }
.float-sfx { color: #ffd54f; font-style: italic; }
.float-skill { color: #9be6ff; background: rgba(12,22,34,0.9); border: 1px solid #3b7ea1; }
.skill-banner { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 78%; background: rgba(18, 12, 28, 0.94); border: 2px solid #a855f7; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.75); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; text-align: center; z-index: 8; animation: bannerPop 1.6s ease-out forwards; }
.skill-banner-ico { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.1; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.skill-banner-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #f3e8ff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.skill-banner-sub { font-size: 10px; color: #d8b4fe; margin-top: 3px; font-style: italic; }
@keyframes bannerPop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.7); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.04); } 82% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -55%) scale(0.95); } }
@keyframes popBack { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.9); } 15% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1.05); } 82% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-22px) scale(0.95); } }
.stat-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; background: #140e0e; border: 1px solid #4a1c1c; padding: 5px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 10px; }
.xp-strip { background: #101614; border: 1px solid #2e523f; color: #9be6b8; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 10px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: space-between; }
.abilities-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.feed { background: #080908; border: 1px solid #3d1c1c; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px; height: 145px; overflow-y: auto; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; }
.feed-line { padding: 2px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed #1f1212; }
.authors-footer { margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #6e2626; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: #d68a8a; line-height: 1.45; }
.authors-portraits { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.author-card { width: 58px; height: 70px; border: 1px solid #6e2626; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #140e0e; }
.author-card svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.hidden { display: none !important; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="box" style="padding:6px 8px;">
<div class="hdr" style="margin-bottom:0;border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0;">
<b>⚔️ S-T-I-K-S // BSIM v2.4</b>
<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;">
<button id="btn-bgm" class="btn btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_AUDIO.toggleBgm()">🎵 1/23: ВЫКЛ</button>
<button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_AUDIO.nextTrack(true)" title="Следующий трек">⏭️</button>
<button id="btn-mode-toggle" class="btn btn-sm hidden" onclick="BSIM_UI.showSetup()">⚙️ Конструктор</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ЭКРАН 1: КОНСТРУКТОР ПОДГОТОВКИ БОЯ -->
<div id="screen-setup">
<div class="box">
<div style="color:#ff9e9e;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;">1. БОЕЦ, РЕЖИМ ЯДРА И СНАРЯЖЕНИЕ</div>
<div class="grid-3">
<div>
<label>Режим боя</label>
<select id="sim-mode">
<option value="sandbox" selected>🧪 Песочница (1M HP)</option>
<option value="game">⚔️ Реальный бой (Ядро)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label>Локация (SVG)</label>
<select id="sim-loc">
<option value="city">🏙️ Город</option>
<option value="ruins">🏚️ Развалины</option>
<option value="park">🌳 Парк</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label>Архетип / Форма</label>
<select id="sim-arch" onchange="BSIM_UI.syncSexByArch()"></select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="grid-3">
<div>
<label>Пол / Уровень</label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:3px;">
<select id="sim-sex" style="flex:1;">
<option value="m">М</option>
<option value="f">Ж</option>
</select>
<input id="sim-lvl" type="number" min="0" max="60" value="15" style="flex:1;">
</div>
</div>
<div>
<label>Оружие (Ранг 1–4)</label>
<select id="sim-weap">
<option value="none">Без оружия (кулаки/когти)</option>
<option value="melee_1">Холодное Р1 (Нож)</option>
<option value="melee_3">Холодное Р3 (Мачете)</option>
<option value="gun_1">Огнестрел Р1 (Обрез 12к)</option>
<option value="gun_2" selected>Огнестрел Р2 (АК-74)</option>
<option value="gun_3">Огнестрел Р3 (ВСС Винторез)</option>
<option value="gun_4">Огнестрел Р4 (Гаусс-М1)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div>
<label>Броня (Класс 0–4)</label>
<select id="sim-armor">
<option value="0">Без брони (0)</option>
<option value="1">Класс 1 (Защита 5)</option>
<option value="2" selected>Класс 2 (Защита 15)</option>
<option value="3">Класс 3 (Защита 30)</option>
<option value="4">Класс 4 (Защита 75)</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="box">
<div style="color:#d6b8ff;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;">2. ВЫУЧЕННЫЕ ДАРЫ УЛЬЯ И ВЕТКИ</div>
<div class="grid-3">
<div>
<label>Дар (16)</label>
<select id="sim-dar" onchange="BSIM_UI.syncBranches()"></select>
</div>
<div>
<label>База / Ветка</label>
<select id="sim-branch"></select>
</div>
<div>
<label>Ур. Дара (1–30)</label>
<div style="display:flex;gap:3px;">
<input id="sim-darlvl" type="number" min="1" max="30" value="15" style="flex:1;">
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_UI.addLearnedGift()">+ Взять</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="learned-list" class="chip-list"></div>
</div>
<div class="box">
<div style="color:#ff9e9e;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;">3. СБОРНЫЙ ОТРЯД ВРАГОВ (ДО 6 В ОДНОЙ СХВАТКЕ)</div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:6px;">
<select id="sim-erank" style="flex:2;"></select>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_UI.addEnemyToRoster()">+ Добавить врага</button>
</div>
<div id="enemy-roster-list" class="chip-list"></div>
<button class="btn btn-ok" style="width:100%;padding:9px;font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;" onclick="BSIM_UI.enterBattle()">⚔️ НАЧАТЬ БОЙ</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- ЭКРАН 2: БОЕВАЯ СЦЕНА И КНОПКИ СПОСОБНОСТЕЙ -->
<div id="screen-battle" class="hidden">
<div id="combat-stage">
<svg id="stage-bg-svg" viewBox="0 0 400 240" preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg>
<div id="stage-dist" class="dist-pill">Раунд 1</div>
<div id="col-allies" class="col-fighters" style="left:4%;"></div>
<div id="col-enemies" class="col-fighters" style="right:2%;"></div>
<div id="stage-floats" class="float-layer"></div>
</div>
<div class="box">
<div id="sim-bars" class="stat-strip"></div>
<div id="sim-xp-strip" class="xp-strip"></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;">
<button id="btn-act-atk" class="btn btn-primary" style="flex:2;" onclick="BSIM_UI.actAttack()">🎲 Атака (2d6)</button>
<button id="btn-refill-mana" class="btn btn-mana" style="flex:1;" onclick="BSIM_UI.refillMana()">🔮 Мана 100%</button>
</div>
<div id="battle-abilities" class="abilities-grid"></div>
<div id="sim-feed" class="feed"></div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- БЛОК АВТОРОВ ПРОЕКТА (С ДВУМЯ ВЕКТОРНЫМИ ПОРТРЕТАМИ ИЗ ЯДРА) -->
<div id="authors-footer" class="authors-footer">
<div class="authors-portraits">
<div class="author-card" title="Автор №1">
<svg viewBox="0 0 360 440" xmlns="http://w3.org">

<circle cx="220" cy="246" r="6" fill="#38bdf8"/>
<path d="M158 244 Q180 256 202 244" fill="none" stroke="#8c5843" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
</div>
<div class="author-card" title="Автор №2">
<svg viewBox="0 0 360 440" xmlns="http://w3.org">
<rect width="360" height="440" fill="#111613"/>
<path d="M245 225 C285 245, 295 315, 275 365 C262 340, 255 290, 240 265 Z" fill="#5c3a21"/>

<rect x="218" y="378" width="54" height="62" rx="6" fill="#e2e8f0" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="230" y="344" width="30" height="44" rx="4" fill="#d99b82" stroke="#8c533e" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="230" y1="344" x2="260" y2="344" stroke="#f3c6b4" stroke-width="4"/>
<path d="M95 405 Q180 385 265 405" fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<ellipse cx="180" cy="195" rx="68" ry="86" fill="#f5d0ba"/>

<circle cx="154" cy="190" r="6" fill="#3b2f2f"/>
<circle cx="206" cy="190" r="6" fill="#3b2f2f"/>
<path d="M164 238 Q173 232 180 237 Q187 232 196 238 Q180 250 164 238 Z" fill="#d97777"/>
</svg>
</div>
</div>
<div>Авторы проекта — семейство эльфов</div>
<div style="font-size:10px;color:#b87474;">по мотивам произведений Артема Каменистого</div>
</div>

ensureCtx() {
if (!this.ctx) {
const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
if (AC) this.ctx = new AC();
}
if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
}
return this.ctx;
},
updateBtnLabel() {
const btn = document.getElementById('btn-bgm');
if (btn) btn.textContent = '🎵 ' + (this.trackIdx + 1) + '/' + this.TRACKS.length + ': ' + (this.bgmOn ? 'ВКЛ' : 'ВЫКЛ');
},
nextTrack(announce) {
this.trackIdx = (this.trackIdx + 1) % this.TRACKS.length;
this.stepIdx = 0;
this.updateBtnLabel();
if (this.bgmOn) {
this.startLoop();
}
const tr = this.TRACKS.at(this.trackIdx);
if (announce && window.BSIM_UI && tr) {
window.BSIM_UI.log('🎵 Трек ' + (this.trackIdx + 1) + '/' + this.TRACKS.length + ': <b>' + tr.name + '</b>');
}
},
toggleBgm() {
this.bgmOn = !this.bgmOn;
this.updateBtnLabel();
if (this.bgmOn) {
this.ensureCtx();
this.stepIdx = 0;
this.startLoop();
const tr = this.TRACKS.at(this.trackIdx);
if (window.BSIM_UI && tr) {
window.BSIM_UI.log('🎵 Играет (' + (this.trackIdx + 1) + '/' + this.TRACKS.length + '): <b>' + tr.name + '</b>');
}
} else if (this.bgmTimer) {
clearInterval(this.bgmTimer);
this.bgmTimer = null;
}
},
startLoop() {
if (this.bgmTimer) clearInterval(this.bgmTimer);
const tr = this.TRACKS.at(this.trackIdx) || this.TRACKS.at(0);
const stepMs = (tr && tr.ms) ? tr.ms : 190;
this.bgmTimer = setInterval(() => {
if (!this.bgmOn) return;
const c = this.ensureCtx();
if (!c) return;
const curTr = this.TRACKS.at(this.trackIdx) || this.TRACKS.at(0);
const seq = curTr.notes || [];
const note = seq.at(this.stepIdx % seq.length);
this.stepIdx++;
if (note && note.f > 0) {
const now = c.currentTime;
const o = c.createOscillator();
const g = c.createGain();
o.type = note.t;
o.frequency.setValueAtTime(note.f, now);
g.gain.setValueAtTime(note.v, now);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + note.d);
o.connect(g);
g.connect(c.destination);
o.start(now);
o.stop(now + note.d + 0.01);
}
}, stepMs);
},
playSfx(kind) {
const c = this.ensureCtx();
if (!c) return;
const now = c.currentTime;
if (kind === 'gun') {
const buf = c.createBuffer(1, c.sampleRate * 0.16, c.sampleRate);
const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-i / (c.sampleRate * 0.04));
const src = c.createBufferSource();
src.buffer = buf;
const g = c.createGain();
g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.16);
src.connect(g);
g.connect(c.destination);
src.start(now);
} else if (kind === 'melee') {
const o = c.createOscillator();
const g = c.createGain();
o.type = 'sawtooth';
o.frequency.setValueAtTime(420, now);
o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(75, now + 0.14);
g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.14, now);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.15);
o.connect(g);
g.connect(c.destination);
o.start(now);
o.stop(now + 0.16);
} else if (kind === 'card') {
const o = c.createOscillator();
const g = c.createGain();
o.type = 'sine';
o.frequency.setValueAtTime(950, now);
o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(420, now + 0.06);
g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.09, now);

state: null,
calcMana(m1, m30, lvl) {
if (!m1 && !m30) return 0;
const ratio = (Math.max(1, Math.min(30, lvl)) - 1) / 29;
return Math.max(0, Math.round(m1 - (m1 - m30) * ratio));
},
calcMaxCharges(lvl) {
const l = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, Number(lvl) || 1));
if (l >= 30) return 4;
if (l >= 20) return 3;
if (l >= 10) return 2;
return 1;
},
getPlayerRankByLvl(lvl) {
const l = Math.max(0, Number(lvl) || 0);

for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
if (l >= rows.at(i).minLvl && l <= rows.at(i).maxLvl) return rows.at(i).r;
}
return l > 60 ? 9 : 0;
},
getMult(wCls, eRank) {

if (wCls >= 4 && d >= 0) return 3;
return 1;
},

if (p.archKey === 'tatan' && p.lvl >= 15 && (statKey === 'agi' || statKey === 'spd') && m < 1) m = 1;
if (p.archKey === 'asiat' && p.lvl >= 15 && (statKey === 'int' || statKey === 'spi') && m < 1) m = 1;
const delta = Math.round(baseDelta * m * 100) / 100;
if (delta <= 0) return 0;
p.stats[statKey] = Math.round(((Number(p.stats[statKey]) || 10) + delta) * 100) / 100;
p.xpGained[statKey] = Math.round(((Number(p.xpGained[statKey]) || 0) + delta) * 100) / 100;
p.stat = Math.round((p.stats.str + p.stats.agi + p.stats.spd + p.stats.end + p.stats.int + p.stats.spi) / 6);
if (st.mode === 'game') {
const oldMax = p.maxHp;
p.maxHp = Math.max(10, 10 + Math.floor(p.stats.end));
if (p.maxHp > oldMax) p.hp += (p.maxHp - oldMax);
p.maxMana = Math.max(15, 10 + Math.floor(p.stats.spi));
}
return delta;
},
start(cfg) {
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const mode = cfg.mode === 'game' ? 'game' : 'sandbox';
const arch = D.ARCHETYPES[cfg.archKey] || D.ARCHETYPES.kachok;
const weap = D.WEAPONS[cfg.weapKey] || D.WEAPONS.gun_2;
let img = arch.img || 'img/kachok.jpeg';
if (cfg.archKey === 'psih') img = cfg.sex === 'f' ? arch.imgF : arch.imgM;
if (cfg.archKey === 'kvaz') img = cfg.sex === 'f' ? arch.imgF : arch.imgM;
const lvl = Math.max(0, Number(cfg.lvl) || 0);
const pRank = this.getPlayerRankByLvl(lvl);
const baseSt = Object.assign({ str: 10, agi: 10, spd: 10, end: 10, int: 10, spi: 10 }, arch.stats || {});
const multSt = (D.MULT_MAP && D.MULT_MAP[cfg.archKey]) || {};
const stats = {};
['str', 'agi', 'spd', 'end', 'int', 'spi'].forEach(k => {
stats[k] = Math.round((baseSt[k] + lvl * 1.6 * (Number(multSt[k]) || 1)) * 10) / 10;
});
const statAvg = Math.round((stats.str + stats.agi + stats.spd + stats.end + stats.int + stats.spi) / 6);
const realMaxHp = Math.max(10, 10 + Math.floor(stats.end));
const realMaxMana = Math.max(25, 10 + Math.floor(stats.spi) * 2);
const pMaxHp = mode === 'sandbox' ? 1000000 : realMaxHp;
const pMaxMana = mode === 'sandbox' ? Math.max(100, 10 + statAvg * 2) : realMaxMana;
const rList = (cfg.enemyRanks && cfg.enemyRanks.length) ? cfg.enemyRanks : Array.of(1, 3, 2);
const enemies = rList.map((rNum, idx) => {
const zInfo = D.Z_RANKS.find(z => z.r === rNum) || D.Z_RANKS.at(0);
const eDist = weap.isGun ? Math.max(0, 2 + (pRank - zInfo.r)) : 0;
const eHp = mode === 'sandbox' ? 1000000 : (zInfo.hp || 40);
return {
id: 'en_' + idx,
name: zInfo.name + (rList.length > 1 ? ' #' + (idx + 1) : ''),
rank: zInfo.r,
dist: eDist,
maxDist: Math.max(1, eDist),
hp: eHp,
maxHp: eHp,
agi: zInfo.agi,
dmg: zInfo.dmg,
sound: zInfo.sound,
sfx: zInfo.sfx || 'bite',
stun: 0,
debuff: 0,
dead: false
};
});
let stoneBonus = 0;
const learnedWithCharges = (cfg.learned || []).map(item => {
const dar = D.DARS[item.darKey];
const br = (dar && item.branchId) ? dar.branches.find(b => b.id === item.branchId) : null;
const tp = br ? br.type : (dar ? dar.type : 'active');
if (item.darKey === 'stone_skin' && !item.branchId) {
stoneBonus += Math.round((1.0 + (item.lvl - 1) * 0.1) * 5);
}
const maxC = tp === 'passive' ? 0 : this.calcMaxCharges(item.lvl);
return {
darKey: item.darKey,
branchId: item.branchId || '',
lvl: item.lvl,
charges: maxC,
maxCharges: maxC,
usedRound: false
};
});
this.state = {
mode: mode,
loc: cfg.loc,
round: 1,
busy: false,
finished: false,
activeId: '',
player: {
name: arch.name,
archKey: cfg.archKey,
ico: arch.ico || '✨',
lvl: lvl,
rank: pRank,
img: img,
hp: pMaxHp,
maxHp: pMaxHp,
mana: pMaxMana,
maxMana: pMaxMana,
stats: stats,
xpGained: { str: 0, agi: 0, spd: 0, end: 0, int: 0, spi: 0 },
stat: statAvg,
weap: weap,
armCls: cfg.armCls,
armFlat: (D.ARMOR_FLAT[cfg.armCls] || 0) + stoneBonus,
skill: arch.skill,
skillType: arch.skillType || 'active',
skillUsed: false,
phrase: arch.phrase,
learned: learnedWithCharges,
buff: 1,
shieldHits: 0
},
enemies: enemies
};
return this.state;
}
};
window.BSIM_UI = {
learned: [
{ darKey: 'sonic', branchId: '', lvl: 15 },
{ darKey: 'tank', branchId: '', lvl: 15 }
],
enemyRanks: Array.of(1, 3, 5),
battlesCount: 0,
wait(ms) {
return new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, ms));
},
init() {
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const aSel = document.getElementById('sim-arch');
if (aSel) {
aSel.innerHTML = Object.keys(D.ARCHETYPES).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '">' + D.ARCHETYPES[k].name + '</option>').join('');
aSel.value = 'kachok';
}
const eSel = document.getElementById('sim-erank');
if (eSel) {
eSel.innerHTML = D.Z_RANKS.map(z => '<option value="' + z.r + '">Р.' + z.r + ' ' + z.name + '</option>').join('');
eSel.value = '5';
}
const dSel = document.getElementById('sim-dar');
if (dSel) {
dSel.innerHTML = Object.keys(D.DARS).map(k => '<option value="' + k + '">' + D.DARS[k].name + '</option>').join('');
dSel.value = 'sonic';
}
this.syncSexByArch();
this.syncBranches();
this.renderSetupLists();
},
syncSexByArch() {
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const aKey = (document.getElementById('sim-arch') || {}).value || 'kachok';
const sSel = document.getElementById('sim-sex');
const arch = D.ARCHETYPES[aKey];
if (!sSel || !arch) return;
if (arch.sex === 'f') {
sSel.value = 'f';
sSel.disabled = true;
} else if (arch.sex === 'm') {
sSel.value = 'm';
sSel.disabled = true;
} else {
sSel.disabled = false;
}
},
syncBranches() {
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const dKey = (document.getElementById('sim-dar') || {}).value || '';
const bSel = document.getElementById('sim-branch');
if (!bSel || !D.DARS[dKey]) return;
bSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">[База] ' + D.DARS[dKey].name + '</option>' +
D.DARS[dKey].branches.map(b => '<option value="' + b.id + '">[Ветка] ' + b.name + '</option>').join('');
},
addLearnedGift() {
const dKey = (document.getElementById('sim-dar') || {}).value || '';
const branchId = (document.getElementById('sim-branch') || {}).value || '';
const lvl = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, Number((document.getElementById('sim-darlvl') || {}).value) || 1));
if (!dKey) return;
const exists = this.learned.find(x => x.darKey === dKey && x.branchId === branchId);
if (exists) exists.lvl = lvl;
else this.learned.push({ darKey: dKey, branchId: branchId, lvl: lvl });
this.renderSetupLists();
},
removeLearned(idx) {
this.learned.splice(idx, 1);
this.renderSetupLists();
},
addEnemyToRoster() {
if (this.enemyRanks.length >= 6) return;
const r = Number((document.getElementById('sim-erank') || {}).value) || 0;
this.enemyRanks.push(r);
this.renderSetupLists();
},
removeEnemyRoster(idx) {
if (this.enemyRanks.length <= 1) return;
this.enemyRanks.splice(idx, 1);
this.renderSetupLists();
},
renderSetupLists() {
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const lBox = document.getElementById('learned-list');
if (lBox) {
if (!this.learned.length) {
lBox.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:10px;color:#7a6060;">Дары не выбраны (доступен только навык архетипа).</div>';
} else {
lBox.innerHTML = this.learned.map((item, idx) => {
const dar = D.DARS[item.darKey];
const br = item.branchId ? dar.branches.find(b => b.id === item.branchId) : null;
const title = br ? (dar.name + ' → ' + br.name) : dar.name;
const tp = br ? br.type : dar.type;
const tag = tp === 'passive' ? 'ПАССИВ' : (tp === 'trigger' ? 'ТРИГГЕР' : 'АКТИВ');
const maxC = tp === 'passive' ? '∞' : (window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.calcMaxCharges(item.lvl) + ' зар.');
return '<div class="chip-row"><span>🧬 <b>' + title + '</b> (Ур.' + item.lvl + ') [' + tag + ' • ' + maxC + ']</span><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_UI.removeLearned(' + idx + ')">✖</button></div>';
}).join('');
}
}
const eBox = document.getElementById('enemy-roster-list');
if (eBox) {
eBox.innerHTML = this.enemyRanks.map((r, idx) => {
const z = D.Z_RANKS.find(x => x.r === r) || D.Z_RANKS.at(0);
return '<div class="chip-row"><span>🧟 <b>Р.' + z.r + ' ' + z.name + '</b> (ОЗ: ' + z.hp + ', Ур.' + z.minLvl + '-' + z.maxLvl + ')</span><button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="BSIM_UI.removeEnemyRoster(' + idx + ')">✖</button></div>';
}).join('');
}
},
showSetup() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (st && st.busy) return;
document.getElementById('screen-battle').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('screen-setup').classList.remove('hidden');
document.getElementById('btn-mode-toggle').classList.add('hidden');
},
enterBattle() {
if (!this.enemyRanks.length) this.enemyRanks = new Array(1).fill(0);
if (this.battlesCount > 0 && window.BSIM_AUDIO) {
window.BSIM_AUDIO.nextTrack(false);
}
this.battlesCount++;
const cfg = {
mode: (document.getElementById('sim-mode') || {}).value || 'sandbox',
loc: (document.getElementById('sim-loc') || {}).value || 'city',
archKey: (document.getElementById('sim-arch') || {}).value || 'kachok',
sex: (document.getElementById('sim-sex') || {}).value || 'm',
lvl: Number((document.getElementById('sim-lvl') || {}).value) || 15,
weapKey: (document.getElementById('sim-weap') || {}).value || 'gun_2',
armCls: Number((document.getElementById('sim-armor') || {}).value) || 2,
learned: this.learned,
enemyRanks: this.enemyRanks
};
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.start(cfg);
document.getElementById('screen-setup').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('screen-battle').classList.remove('hidden');
document.getElementById('btn-mode-toggle').classList.remove('hidden');
const refillBtn = document.getElementById('btn-refill-mana');
if (refillBtn) {
if (st.mode === 'game') refillBtn.classList.add('hidden');
else refillBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
}
const svg = document.getElementById('stage-bg-svg');
if (svg) svg.innerHTML = window.BSIM_DATA.getSceneBgSvg(cfg.loc);
const feed = document.getElementById('sim-feed');
if (feed) feed.innerHTML = '';
this.renderBattle();
const modeLbl = st.mode === 'game' ? 'РЕАЛЬНЫЙ БОЙ (ЯДРО)' : 'ПЕСОЧНИЦА (1M HP)';
const distInfo = st.enemies.map(e => e.name + ' (' + e.dist + ' х.)').join(', ');
this.log('⚔️ Бой #' + this.battlesCount + ' [' + modeLbl + '] | Ур.' + cfg.lvl + ' (усл. Ранг ' + st.player.rank + ') | Дистанция: ' + distInfo);
},
refillMana() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st || st.busy || st.mode === 'game') return;
st.player.mana = st.player.maxMana;
st.player.learned.forEach(item => { item.charges = item.maxCharges; item.usedRound = false; });
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.popBack('u-player', true, '🔮 Мана и заряды 100%', 'float-skill');
this.log('🔮 Мана и заряды всех Даров восполнены до 100%!');
this.renderBattle();
},
log(html) {
const feed = document.getElementById('sim-feed');
if (!feed) return;
const d = document.createElement('div');
d.className = 'feed-line';
d.innerHTML = html;
feed.appendChild(d);
feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
},
showSkillBanner(ico, title, shout) {
const layer = document.getElementById('stage-floats');
if (!layer) return;
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.className = 'skill-banner';
el.innerHTML = '<div class="skill-banner-ico">' + ico + '</div><div class="skill-banner-title">' + title + '</div><div class="skill-banner-sub">«' + shout + '»</div>';
layer.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentNode) el.remove(); }, 1650);
},
popBack(unitDomId, isLeftSide, txt, cls) {
const layer = document.getElementById('stage-floats');
const unit = document.getElementById(unitDomId);
const stage = document.getElementById('combat-stage');
if (!layer || !unit || !stage) return;
const uRect = unit.getBoundingClientRect();
const sRect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.className = 'float-pop ' + cls;
el.textContent = txt;
el.style.top = Math.max(20, Math.round(uRect.top - sRect.top - 4)) + 'px';
if (isLeftSide) {
el.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.round(uRect.left - sRect.left - 6)) + 'px';
} else {
el.style.right = Math.max(4, Math.round(sRect.right - uRect.right - 6)) + 'px';
}
layer.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentNode) el.remove(); }, 1500);
},
setButtonsDisabled(flag) {
const box = document.getElementById('screen-battle');
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!box || !st) return;
box.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b => {
if (st.finished) {
b.disabled = true;
} else if (b.id === 'btn-skill-act' && st.player.skillUsed) {
b.disabled = true;
} else if (b.dataset && b.dataset.darIdx !== undefined) {
const dItem = st.player.learned.at(Number(b.dataset.darIdx));
const noChg = dItem && dItem.maxCharges > 0 && dItem.charges <= 0;
b.disabled = flag || (dItem && dItem.usedRound) || noChg;
} else {
b.disabled = flag;
}
});
},
renderBattle() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st) return;
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const p = st.player;
const colA = document.getElementById('col-allies');
const colE = document.getElementById('col-enemies');
if (colA) {
colA.style.left = '4%';
const pFb = encodeURIComponent(D.getRankFallbackSvg(p.rank, true));
const actCls = st.activeId === 'u-player' ? ' active-turn' : '';
const pDeadCls = p.hp <= 0 ? ' dead' : '';
const pPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((p.hp / Math.max(1, p.maxHp)) * 100)));
colA.innerHTML = '<div id="u-player" class="mini-unit ally' + actCls + pDeadCls + '"><div class="mini-pic"><img src="' + p.img + '" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src=\'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + pFb + '\';"></div><div class="mini-meta"><div class="mini-lbl">' + p.name + '</div><div class="mini-bar"><div class="mini-fill ally" style="width:' + pPct + '%;"></div></div></div></div>';
}
if (colE) {
colE.style.right = '2%';
colE.style.width = '64%';
colE.innerHTML = st.enemies.map(en => {
const eFb = encodeURIComponent(D.getRankFallbackSvg(en.rank, false));
const ratio = en.maxDist > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, en.dist / en.maxDist)) : 0;
const rPct = en.dist <= 0 ? 52 : Math.round(2 + (1 - ratio) * 44);
const actCls = st.activeId === ('u-' + en.id) ? ' active-turn' : '';
const deadCls = en.dead ? ' dead' : '';
const stunCls = (!en.dead && en.stun > 0) ? ' stun' : ((!en.dead && en.debuff > 0) ? ' debuff' : '');
let topBadge = '';
if (!en.dead && en.stun > 0) topBadge = '<div class="stun-tag">💫 ОГЛУШЁН (' + en.stun + ')</div>';
else if (!en.dead && en.debuff > 0) topBadge = '<div class="debuff-tag">⬇️ ДЕБАФ -25% (' + en.debuff + ')</div>';
const distTag = en.dead ? ' [💀]' : (en.dist > 0 ? (' [' + en.dist + 'х]') : ' [УПОР]');
const ePct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((en.hp / Math.max(1, en.maxHp)) * 100)));
return '<div class="enemy-lane"><div id="u-' + en.id + '" class="mini-unit enemy' + actCls + stunCls + deadCls + '" style="right:' + rPct + '%;">' + topBadge + '<div class="mini-pic"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;utf8,' + eFb + '"></div><div class="mini-meta"><div class="mini-lbl">' + en.name + '<span class="dist-mini">' + distTag + '</span></div><div class="mini-bar"><div class="mini-fill" style="width:' + ePct + '%;"></div></div></div></div></div>';
}).join('');
}
const distEl = document.getElementById('stage-dist');
if (distEl) {
const aliveCnt = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead).length;
const closeCnt = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead && e.dist <= 0).length;
if (st.finished) {
distEl.textContent = p.hp > 0 ? '🏆 БОЙ ЗАВЕРШЁН (ПОБЕДА)' : '💀 БОЙ ЗАВЕРШЁН (ПОРАЖЕНИЕ)';
} else {
distEl.textContent = st.busy ? ('Раунд ' + st.round + ' • Идёт обмен ударами...') : ('Раунд ' + st.round + ' • Живых: ' + aliveCnt + ' (В упор: ' + closeCnt + ')');
}
}
const bars = document.getElementById('sim-bars');
if (bars) {
const hpTxt = st.mode === 'game' ? (p.hp + '/' + p.maxHp) : p.hp.toLocaleString('ru-RU');
bars.innerHTML = '<div>❤️ ОЗ: <b>' + hpTxt + '</b></div><div>🔮 Мана: <b>' + p.mana + '/' + p.maxMana + '</b></div><div>🛡 Броня: <b>' + p.armFlat + ' (Р' + p.armCls + ')</b></div>';
}
const xpStrip = document.getElementById('sim-xp-strip');
if (xpStrip) {
const names = { str: 'Сил', agi: 'Ловк', spd: 'Скор', end: 'Вын', int: 'Инт', spi: 'Дух' };
const parts = Object.keys(names).map(k => {
const g = p.xpGained[k] || 0;
const gStr = g > 0 ? (' <b style="color:#4ade80;">(+' + g + ')</b>') : '';
return names[k] + ':' + p.stats[k] + gStr;
});
xpStrip.innerHTML = '<span>📈 Статы: ' + parts.join(' • ') + '</span>';
}
const abBox = document.getElementById('battle-abilities');
if (abBox) {
let abHtml = '';
if (p.skillType === 'trigger' || p.skillType === 'passive') {
abHtml += '<div id="badge-skill" class="passive-badge"><span>' + p.ico + ' [Триггер] ' + p.skill + '</span><span>АВТО</span></div>';
} else {
const usedTxt = p.skillUsed ? ' (Использовано)' : ' (Бонус)';
abHtml += '<button id="btn-skill-act" class="btn" style="text-align:left;" onclick="BSIM_UI.actSkill()">' + p.ico + ' [Навык] ' + p.skill + usedTxt + '</button>';
}
p.learned.forEach((item, idx) => {
const dar = D.DARS[item.darKey];
if (!dar) return;
const br = item.branchId ? dar.branches.find(b => b.id === item.branchId) : null;
const title = br ? br.name : dar.name;
const tp = br ? br.type : dar.type;
const pct = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.calcMana(br ? br.mana1 : dar.mana1, br ? br.mana30 : dar.mana30, item.lvl);
const cost = Math.floor(p.maxMana * (pct / 100));
const chgTxt = item.maxCharges > 0 ? (' [' + item.charges + '/' + item.maxCharges + ']') : ' [∞]';
if (tp === 'passive' || tp === 'trigger') {
const emptyCls = (item.maxCharges > 0 && item.charges <= 0) ? ' empty' : '';
abHtml += '<div id="badge-dar-' + idx + '" class="passive-badge' + emptyCls + '"><span>🧬 [' + (tp === 'trigger' ? 'Триггер' : 'Пассив') + '] ' + title + ' (Ур.' + item.lvl + ')' + chgTxt + '</span><span>' + (cost > 0 ? cost + ' м.' : '0%') + '</span></div>';
} else {
const rTxt = item.usedRound ? ' • Готово в след. р.' : (' • ' + cost + ' м. (Без траты атаки)');
abHtml += '<button data-dar-idx="' + idx + '" class="btn btn-dar" onclick="BSIM_UI.actLearned(' + idx + ')">🧬 ' + title + ' (Ур.' + item.lvl + chgTxt + rTxt + ')</button>';
}
});
abBox.innerHTML = abHtml;
}
this.setButtonsDisabled(st.busy);
},
getTargetsPool() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st || !st.enemies.length) return [];
const alive = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead);
if (!alive.length) return [];
const sorted = alive.slice().sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist);
if (!st.player.weap.isGun) {
const close = sorted.filter(e => e.dist <= 0);
return close.length ? close : sorted.slice(0, 1);
}
return sorted;
},
checkBattleEnd() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st || st.mode !== 'game' || st.finished) return false;
const alive = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead);
if (!alive.length) {
st.finished = true;
st.busy = false;
st.activeId = '';
this.log('🏆 <b>ПОБЕДА!</b> Все противники уничтожены!');
this.renderBattle();
return true;
}
if (st.player.hp <= 0) {
st.finished = true;
st.busy = false;
st.activeId = '';
this.log('💀 <b>ПОРАЖЕНИЕ!</b> ' + st.player.name + ' пал в бою.');
this.renderBattle();
return true;
}
return false;
},
async actAttack() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st || st.busy || st.finished) return;
const p = st.player;
const pool = this.getTargetsPool();
if (!pool.length) return;
st.busy = true;
st.activeId = 'u-player';
this.renderBattle();
let reroll = true;
let combo = 0;
while (reroll && combo < 5) {
reroll = false;
combo++;
const curPool = this.getTargetsPool();
if (!curPool.length) break;
const d1 = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
const d2 = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
const isDouble = (d1 === d2);
const isCritLuck = (d1 === 1 && d2 === 1);
const isCritFail = (d1 === 6 && d2 === 6);
if (isDouble) {
window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.grantCombatXp('spi', 1);
}
if (isCritFail) {
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('bite');
this.popBack('u-player', true, '🎲 [6-6] ОСЕЧКА!', 'float-crit');
this.log('💀 Бросок <b>[6-6] КРИТ НЕУДАЧИ</b>: срыв атаки / осечка!');
await this.wait(1400);
break;
}
const targets = curPool.slice(0, Math.min(d1, curPool.length));
const dblTag = isCritLuck ? ' <span style="color:#ff4444;">[1-1 КРИТ УДАЧИ + ПЕРЕБРОС!]</span>' : (isDouble ? ' <span style="color:#ffd54f;">[ДУБЛЬ ' + d1 + '-' + d2 + ' → ПЕРЕБРОС!]</span>' : '');
this.log('🎲 <b>' + p.name + '</b> бросок <b>[' + d1 + '-' + d2 + ']</b> (целей: ' + targets.length + ', сила +' + d2 + ')' + dblTag);
for (let t = 0; t < targets.length; t++) {
const trg = targets.at(t);
if (trg.dead) continue;
const mult = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.getMult(p.weap.cls, trg.rank);
const statAdd = Math.round((p.weap.isGun ? p.stats.agi * 0.25 : p.stats.str * 0.35));
const base = p.weap.dmg + d2 + statAdd;
let dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * mult * p.buff * (isCritLuck ? 2.0 : 1)));
if (st.mode === 'game') {
trg.hp = Math.max(0, trg.hp - dmg);
if (trg.hp <= 0) trg.dead = true;
} else {
trg.hp = Math.max(1, trg.hp - dmg);
}
const xpStat = p.weap.isGun ? 'agi' : 'str';
const xpGain = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.grantCombatXp(xpStat, 1);
const xpLbl = p.weap.isGun ? 'Ловк' : 'Сил';
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx(isCritLuck ? 'crit' : p.weap.sfx);
this.popBack('u-player', true, p.weap.sound, 'float-sfx');
this.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '-' + dmg + (trg.dead ? ' 💀' : (isCritLuck ? ' КРИТ!' : '')), (isCritLuck || trg.dead) ? 'float-crit' : 'float-dmg');
this.log('↳ ' + p.weap.sound + ' <b>' + trg.name + '</b> [Р' + trg.rank + ']: (ор.' + p.weap.dmg + ' + куб.' + d2 + ' + стат.' + statAdd + ') × ' + mult + ' = <b>-' + dmg + '</b> (ОЗ: ' + trg.hp + ') <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + xpGain + ' ' + xpLbl + ']</span>');
this.renderBattle();
if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;
if (t < targets.length - 1) await this.wait(260);
}
await this.wait(1300);
if (isDouble) reroll = true;
}
if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;
await this.runEnemiesTurn();
},
actSkill() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
if (!st || st.busy || st.finished || st.player.skillUsed) return;
const p = st.player;
const pool = this.getTargetsPool();
if (!pool.length) return;
p.skillUsed = true;
const trg = pool.at(0);
const dmg = Math.round((p.weap.dmg * 1.2 + p.stats.spi * 0.8) * p.buff);
if (st.mode === 'game') {
trg.hp = Math.max(0, trg.hp - dmg);
if (trg.hp <= 0) trg.dead = true;
} else {
trg.hp = Math.max(1, trg.hp - dmg);
}
const isStronger = trg.rank > p.rank;
if (!trg.dead) {
if (isStronger) trg.debuff = Math.max(trg.debuff, 2);
else trg.stun = Math.max(trg.stun, 1);
}
const spiGain = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.grantCombatXp('spi', 1);
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('shout');
this.showSkillBanner(p.ico, p.skill, p.phrase);
const ccPop = trg.dead ? ' 💀' : (isStronger ? ' ⬇️ДЕБАФ' : ' 💫СТАН');
this.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '-' + dmg + ccPop, 'float-crit');
const ccLog = trg.dead ? 'враг повержен!' : (isStronger ? 'сильный враг устоял от стана → <b>Дебаф -25%</b>!' : 'оглушён!');
this.log('🗣️ <b>' + p.name + '</b> кричит: «<b>' + p.phrase + '</b>» → <b>[' + p.skill + ']</b> (бонус): <b>' + trg.name + '</b> (-' + dmg + ', ' + ccLog + ') <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + spiGain + ' Дух]</span>');
this.renderBattle();
this.checkBattleEnd();
},
async actLearned(idx) {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
if (!st || st.busy || st.finished || !st.player.learned.at(idx)) return;
const p = st.player;
const item = p.learned.at(idx);
if (item.usedRound) return;
const dar = D.DARS[item.darKey];
const br = item.branchId ? dar.branches.find(b => b.id === item.branchId) : null;
const title = br ? br.name : dar.name;
if (item.maxCharges > 0 && item.charges <= 0) {
this.popBack('u-player', true, '❌ Заряды 0/' + item.maxCharges, 'float-crit');
this.log('❌ Заряды Дара <b>[' + title + ']</b> на этот бой исчерпаны!');
return;
}
const pct = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.calcMana(br ? br.mana1 : dar.mana1, br ? br.mana30 : dar.mana30, item.lvl);
const cost = Math.floor(p.maxMana * (pct / 100));
if (p.mana < cost) {
this.popBack('u-player', true, '❌ Мало маны!', 'float-crit');
this.log('❌ Не хватает маны на <b>[' + title + ']</b> (нужно ' + cost + ').');
return;
}
st.busy = true;
st.activeId = 'u-player';
p.mana -= cost;
item.usedRound = true;
if (item.maxCharges > 0) item.charges--;
const spiGain = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.grantCombatXp('spi', 1);
this.renderBattle();
const alive = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead);
const intMult = 1 + Math.floor((p.stats.int || 10) / 20) * 0.01;
if (item.darKey === 'illusionist' && !item.branchId) {
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.showSkillBanner('🃏', 'Иллюзионист: 36 Карт!', 'Колода веером по врагам!');
const suits = Array.of('♠️', '♥️', '♦️', '♣️');
const cardDmg = Math.max(2, Math.round((4 + p.stats.int * 0.16 + item.lvl * 0.65) * intMult));
const tally = {};
alive.forEach(e => { tally[e.id] = { name: e.name, hits: 0, total: 0 }; });
for (let c = 0; c < 36; c++) {
const curAlive = st.enemies.filter(e => !e.dead);
if (!curAlive.length) break;
const en = curAlive.at(Math.floor(Math.random() * curAlive.length));
if (st.mode === 'game') {
en.hp = Math.max(0, en.hp - cardDmg);
if (en.hp <= 0) en.dead = true;
} else {
en.hp = Math.max(1, en.hp - cardDmg);
}
tally[en.id].hits++;
tally[en.id].total += cardDmg;
if (c % 2 === 0) window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('card');
if (c % 3 === 0) {
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, suits.at(c % 4) + ' -' + cardDmg + (en.dead ? ' 💀' : ''), 'float-dmg');
}
await this.wait(38);
}
const summary = Object.values(tally).filter(x => x.hits > 0).map(x => '<b>' + x.name + '</b>: ' + x.hits + ' карт (-' + x.total + ')').join(', ');
this.log('🃏 Дар <b>[Иллюзионист: 36 карт]</b> (Ур.' + item.lvl + ', -' + cost + ' м., зар. ' + item.charges + '/' + item.maxCharges + ') → ' + summary + ' <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + spiGain + ' Дух]</span>');
st.activeId = '';
st.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
this.checkBattleEnd();
return;
}
if (item.darKey === 'sonic' && !item.branchId) {
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.showSkillBanner('🔊', 'Соник: Акустический удар!', 'Ударная волна по врагам!');
const ratio = (Math.max(1, Math.min(30, item.lvl)) - 1) / 29;
const pctMult = 1.5 + ratio * 1.5;
const baseWave = Math.round((20 + p.stats.spi * 0.9) * pctMult * intMult);
const resLines = [];
alive.forEach(en => {
const diff = en.rank - p.rank;
if (diff <= 1) {
const stunR = diff < 0 ? 3 : (diff === 0 ? 2 : 1);
const lightDmg = Math.max(2, Math.round(baseWave * 0.35));
if (st.mode === 'game') {
en.hp = Math.max(0, en.hp - lightDmg);
if (en.hp <= 0) en.dead = true;
} else {
en.hp = Math.max(1, en.hp - lightDmg);
}
if (!en.dead) en.stun = Math.max(en.stun, stunR);
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, '-' + lightDmg + (en.dead ? ' 💀' : ' 💫СТАН ' + stunR + 'р'), 'float-crit');
resLines.push('<b>' + en.name + '</b> [Р' + en.rank + ']: -' + lightDmg + ' + стан ' + stunR + 'р');
} else {
const dmg = baseWave;
if (st.mode === 'game') {
en.hp = Math.max(0, en.hp - dmg);
if (en.hp <= 0) en.dead = true;
} else {
en.hp = Math.max(1, en.hp - dmg);
}
if (!en.dead) en.debuff = Math.max(en.debuff, 2);
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, '-' + dmg + (en.dead ? ' 💀' : ' ⬇️ДЕБАФ'), 'float-skill');
resLines.push('<b>' + en.name + '</b> [Р' + en.rank + ', сильнее!]: устоял от стана → <b>-' + dmg + '</b> + <b>Дебаф -25%</b>');
}
});
this.log('🔊 Дар <b>[Соник]</b> (Ур.' + item.lvl + ', -' + cost + ' м., зар. ' + item.charges + '/' + item.maxCharges + ', атака свободна!): ' + resLines.join('; ') + ' <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + spiGain + ' Дух]</span>');
st.activeId = '';
st.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
this.checkBattleEnd();
return;
}
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.showSkillBanner('🧬', title + ' (Ур.' + item.lvl + ')', 'Активация Дара Улья!');
const dmg = Math.round((55 + p.stats.int * 1.1) * (1 + item.lvl * 0.08) * intMult);
const hasControl = (item.darKey === 'ice_master' || item.darKey === 'mentalist' || item.darKey === 'nymph' || item.darKey === 'gigolo_gift' || item.darKey === 'hive_child');
const isShield = (item.darKey === 'stone_skin' || (item.darKey === 'fire_master' && item.branchId === 'b1') || (item.darKey === 'ice_master' && item.branchId === 'b1'));
if (isShield) {
p.shieldHits += 2;
this.popBack('u-player', true, '🛡 Щит +2 уд.', 'float-skill');
this.log('🛡 Дар <b>[' + title + ']</b> (Ур.' + item.lvl + ', -' + cost + ' м., атака свободна!): активирован защитный барьер! <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + spiGain + ' Дух]</span>');
} else {
alive.forEach(en => {
if (st.mode === 'game') {
en.hp = Math.max(0, en.hp - dmg);
if (en.hp <= 0) en.dead = true;
} else {
en.hp = Math.max(1, en.hp - dmg);
}
let tag = en.dead ? ' 💀' : '!';
if (!en.dead && hasControl) {
if (en.rank > p.rank) {
en.debuff = Math.max(en.debuff, 2);
tag = ' ⬇️ДЕБАФ';
} else {
en.stun = Math.max(en.stun, 1);
tag = ' 💫СТАН';
}
}
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, '-' + dmg + tag, 'float-crit');
});
this.log('🧬 Дар <b>[' + title + ']</b> (Ур.' + item.lvl + ', -' + cost + ' м., зар. ' + item.charges + '/' + item.maxCharges + ', атака свободна!): урон <b>-' + dmg + '</b>! <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + spiGain + ' Дух]</span>');
}
st.activeId = '';
st.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
this.checkBattleEnd();
},
tryTankTrigger(rawDmg) {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
const D = window.BSIM_DATA;
const p = st.player;
const tIdx = p.learned.findIndex(x => x.darKey === 'tank' || (x.darKey === 'gigantism' && x.branchId === 'b1'));
if (tIdx < 0) return { blocked: false, dmg: rawDmg };
if (st.mode === 'game' && rawDmg < Math.ceil(p.maxHp * 0.1)) {
return { blocked: false, dmg: rawDmg };
}
const item = p.learned.at(tIdx);
const dar = D.DARS[item.darKey];
const br = item.branchId ? dar.branches.find(b => b.id === item.branchId) : null;
const title = br ? br.name : dar.name;
if (item.maxCharges > 0 && item.charges <= 0) {
return { blocked: false, dmg: rawDmg, exhausted: true, title: title };
}
const pct = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.calcMana(br ? br.mana1 : dar.mana1, br ? br.mana30 : dar.mana30, item.lvl);
const cost = Math.max(1, Math.floor(p.maxMana * (pct / 100)));
if (p.mana < cost) return { blocked: false, dmg: rawDmg };
p.mana -= cost;
if (item.maxCharges > 0) item.charges--;
const badge = document.getElementById('badge-dar-' + tIdx);
if (badge) {
badge.classList.add('flash');
setTimeout(() => badge.classList.remove('flash'), 1200);
}
return { blocked: true, dmg: 0, cost: cost, title: title, left: item.charges, max: item.maxCharges };
},
async runEnemiesTurn() {
const st = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.state;
const p = st.player;
for (let i = 0; i < st.enemies.length; i++) {
const en = st.enemies.at(i);
if (en.dead) continue;
st.activeId = 'u-' + en.id;
this.renderBattle();
if (en.stun > 0) {
en.stun--;
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, '💫 Оглушён', 'float-skill');
this.log('💫 <b>' + en.name + '</b> оглушён и пропускает ход (осталось: ' + en.stun + ').');
this.renderBattle();
await this.wait(1500);
continue;
}
if (en.dist > 0) {
en.dist = Math.max(0, en.dist - 1);
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, en.dist === 0 ? '⚡ В УПОР!' : ('🏃 Шаг (' + en.dist + 'х)'), 'float-sfx');
this.log('🏃 <b>' + en.name + '</b> бежит вперёд → дистанция: <b>' + (en.dist === 0 ? 'В УПОР!' : (en.dist + ' х.')) + '</b>');
this.renderBattle();
await this.wait(1500);
} else {
const debuffMult = en.debuff > 0 ? 0.75 : 1;
if (en.debuff > 0) en.debuff--;
const effDmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(en.dmg * debuffMult));
const raw = Math.max(1, effDmg - p.armFlat);
if (p.shieldHits > 0) {
p.shieldHits--;
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.popBack('u-player', true, '🛡 Барьер!', 'float-skill');
this.log('🛡 Барьер Дара полностью поглотил удар <b>' + en.name + '</b> (осталось ударов: ' + p.shieldHits + ').');
} else {
const trig = this.tryTankTrigger(raw);
if (trig.blocked) {
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx('dar');
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, en.sound, 'float-sfx');
this.popBack('u-player', true, '🛡 ТАНК! (' + trig.left + '/' + trig.max + ')', 'float-skill');
this.log('🛡 Триггер <b>[' + trig.title + ']</b> перехватил удар <b>' + en.name + '</b> (' + effDmg + ' − броня ' + p.armFlat + ' = ' + raw + ') за <b>' + trig.cost + ' маны</b> (зарядов: <b>' + trig.left + '/' + trig.max + '</b>)!');
} else {
if (st.mode === 'game') {
p.hp = Math.max(0, p.hp - raw);
} else {
p.hp = Math.max(1, p.hp - raw);
}
const endGain = window.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.grantCombatXp('end', 1);
window.BSIM_AUDIO.playSfx(en.sfx || 'bite');
this.popBack('u-' + en.id, false, en.sound, 'float-sfx');
this.popBack('u-player', true, '-' + raw, 'float-dmg');
const exTxt = trig.exhausted ? ' <i>(заряды Танка исчерпаны)</i>' : '';
const dbTxt = debuffMult < 1 ? ' [дебаф -25%]' : '';
this.log(en.sound + ' <b>' + en.name + '</b>' + dbTxt + ': база ' + effDmg + ' − броня (' + p.armFlat + ') = <b>-' + raw + '</b> <span style="color:#6ee794;">[+' + endGain + ' Вын]</span>' + exTxt);
}
}
this.renderBattle();
if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;
await this.wait(1700);
}
}
p.skillUsed = false;
p.learned.forEach(item => { item.usedRound = false; });
st.activeId = '';
st.busy = false;
st.round++;
this.renderBattle();
}
};
window.BSIM_UI.init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<script>
// ============================================================================
// ПАТЧ v1.9.0-p3 (BSIM): ПОРТРЕТЫ ЗАРАЖЁННЫХ (Z_01..Z_10) В КАРТОЧКАХ БОЯ
// ============================================================================
(function(global) {
'use strict';
const Z_IMGS = [
'img/Z_01.png', 'img/Z_02.png', 'img/Z_03.png', 'img/Z_04.png', 'img/Z_05.png',
'img/Z_06.png', 'img/Z_07.png', 'img/Z_08.png', 'img/Z_09.png', 'img/Z_10.png'
];
if (global.BSIM_DATA && Array.isArray(global.BSIM_DATA.Z_RANKS)) {
global.BSIM_DATA.Z_RANKS.forEach((z, idx) => {
if (z && Z_IMGS[idx]) z.img = Z_IMGS[idx];
});
}
if (global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE && Array.isArray(global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.Z_RANKS)) {
global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE.Z_RANKS.forEach((z, idx) => {
if (z && Z_IMGS[idx]) z.img = Z_IMGS[idx];
});
}
function resolveEnemyImg(en) {
if (!en) return 'img/Z_01.png';
if (en.img) return en.img;
if (en.isHuman && global.STIKS && global.STIKS.ARCHETYPES) {
const a = global.STIKS.ARCHETYPES[en.arch || 'kachok'];
if (a && a.img) return a.img;
}
const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(9, Number(en.rank) || 0));
return Z_IMGS[idx];
}
if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.getElementById('stiks-bsim-enemy-pic-css')) {
const st = document.createElement('style');
st.id = 'stiks-bsim-enemy-pic-css';
st.textContent = '#col-enemies .mini-pic{background:#1b1416 !important;border:1px solid #4a1c1c;}#col-enemies .mini-pic img{object-fit:contain !important;}';
document.head.appendChild(st);
}
function injectEnemyPortraits() {
const CORE = global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE;
const st = CORE && CORE.state;
if (!st || !Array.isArray(st.enemies)) return;
st.enemies.forEach(en => {
const card = document.getElementById('u-' + en.id);
if (!card) return;
const src = resolveEnemyImg(en);
let picBox = card.querySelector('.mini-pic');
if (!picBox) {
picBox = document.createElement('div');
picBox.className = 'mini-pic';
const img = document.createElement('img');
img.src = src;
picBox.appendChild(img);
card.insertBefore(picBox, card.firstChild);
} else {
const img = picBox.querySelector('img');
if (img && img.getAttribute('src') !== src) {
img.onerror = null;
img.src = src;
}
}
});
}
const UI = global.BSIM_UI;
if (UI) {
if (typeof UI.renderBattle === 'function') {
const origBattle = UI.renderBattle.bind(UI);
UI.renderBattle = function() {
origBattle();
injectEnemyPortraits();
};
}
if (typeof UI.renderStage === 'function') {
const origStage = UI.renderStage.bind(UI);
UI.renderStage = function() {
origStage();
injectEnemyPortraits();
};
}
}
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
<script>
// ============================================================================
// ПАТЧ v1.9.0-p15 (BSIM): БОЕВЫЕ МИНИАТЮРЫ ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫХ (LM_battle / LG_battle)
// ============================================================================
(function(global) {
'use strict';
const DATA = global.BSIM_DATA;
const UI = global.BSIM_UI;
if (!DATA || !DATA.ARCHETYPES || typeof DATA.ARCHETYPES !== 'object') return;
DATA.ARCHETYPES.legend_m = {
name: '👑 Легендарный Воин Улья',
sex: 'm',
img: 'img/LM_battle.png',
ico: '⚡',
skill: 'Ужас Улья',
skillType: 'active',
phrase: 'Вот он — реальный ужас Улья!',
stats: { str: 65, agi: 60, spd: 55, end: 65, int: 50, spi: 55 }
};
DATA.ARCHETYPES.legend_f = {
name: '👑 Легендарная Воительница Улья',
sex: 'f',
img: 'img/LG_battle.png',
ico: '🔥',
skill: 'Ужас Улья',
skillType: 'active',
phrase: 'Вот он — реальный ужас Улья!',
stats: { str: 58, agi: 68, spd: 62, end: 58, int: 55, spi: 60 }
};
if (DATA.MULT_MAP) {
DATA.MULT_MAP.legend_m = { str: 2.5, agi: 2.5, spd: 2.5, end: 2.5, int: 2.0, spi: 2.0 };
DATA.MULT_MAP.legend_f = { str: 2.5, agi: 2.5, spd: 2.5, end: 2.5, int: 2.0, spi: 2.0 };
}
if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && !document.getElementById('stiks-bsim-ally-pic-css')) {
const st = document.createElement('style');
st.id = 'stiks-bsim-ally-pic-css';

UI.showAmuletBanner = function(title, desc) {

el.className = 'skill-banner';
el.style.cssText = 'width:88%;border-color:#f59e0b;background:rgba(24,14,12,0.96);animation:none;opacity:1;';

`<div style="font-size:10px;color:#f8fafc;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.3;">${desc}</div>`;
layer.appendChild(el);
setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentNode) el.remove(); }, 2150);
};
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);

<script>
// ============================================================================
// ПАТЧ v1.9.0-p16b (BSIM): БОЕВЫЕ ТРИГГЕРЫ АМУЛЕТОВ ПОЗОРА И ПАУЗА 2.2 СЕК
// ============================================================================
(function(global) {
'use strict';
const DATA = global.BSIM_DATA;
const CORE = global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE;
const UI = global.BSIM_UI;
const AUD = global.BSIM_AUDIO;
if (!DATA || !CORE || !UI) return;
async function tryFireBsimAmulet(phase) {
const st = CORE.state;
if (!st || st.finished || !st.player) return;
const p = st.player;
const am = DATA.SHAME_AMULETS && DATA.SHAME_AMULETS[p.archKey];
if (!am || am.trig !== phase) return;
if (Math.random() >= 0.25) return;
const alive = (st.enemies || []).filter(e => !e.dead);
if (!alive.length) return;
if (AUD) AUD.playSfx('shout');
UI.showAmuletBanner(am.n, am.log);
UI.log(`🧿 <b>[${am.n}]</b>: ${am.log}`);
const key = p.archKey;
if (key === 'surgeon' || key === 'prof') {
const trg = alive[0];
trg.debuff = Math.max(trg.debuff || 0, 2);
trg.stun = Math.max(trg.stun || 0, 1);
UI.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '💫 УДИВЛЕНИЕ (-25%)', 'float-crit');
} else if (key === 'asiat' || key === 'gigolo') {
alive.slice(0, 2).forEach(e => {
e.stun = Math.max(e.stun || 0, 1);
UI.popBack('u-' + e.id, false, '😂 СТУПОР (1х)', 'float-crit');
});
} else if (key === 'schoolgirl' || key === 'strip' || key === 'kachok') {
const trg = alive[0];
trg.stun = Math.max(trg.stun || 0, 1);
UI.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '💫 ОГЛУШЁН (1х)', 'float-crit');
} else if (key === 'nanny' || key === 'psih' || key === 'legend_m' || key === 'legend_f') {
const top = alive.slice().sort((a, b) => b.rank - a.rank)[0];
top.debuff = Math.max(top.debuff || 0, 2);
UI.popBack('u-' + top.id, false, '😱 СТРАХ (-25%)', 'float-skill');
} else if (key === 'alkash') {
p.buff = Math.max(p.buff || 1, 1.5);
const heal = Math.max(1, Math.round(p.maxHp * 0.10));
p.hp = Math.min(p.maxHp, p.hp + heal);
UI.popBack('u-player', true, `🔥 КУРАЖ (+${heal} ОЗ)`, 'float-skill');
} else if (key === 'cashier') {
const trg = alive[0];
trg.dist = (trg.dist || 0) + 1;
trg.debuff = Math.max(trg.debuff || 0, 2);
UI.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '😱 ОТСТУПИЛ (-25%)', 'float-skill');
} else if (key === 'tatan' || key === 'vet') {
p.buff = Math.max(p.buff || 1, key === 'tatan' ? 1.45 : 1.35);
UI.popBack('u-player', true, '😡 ЯРОСТЬ (+УРОН)', 'float-skill');
} else if (key === 'infected') {
alive.forEach(e => {
if (e.rank < p.rank) { e.stun = Math.max(e.stun || 0, 1); UI.popBack('u-' + e.id, false, '😱 УЖАС (1х)', 'float-crit'); }
else { e.debuff = Math.max(e.debuff || 0, 2); UI.popBack('u-' + e.id, false, '😂 ХОХОТ (-25%)', 'float-skill'); }
});
} else if (key === 'kvaz') {
const trg = alive[0];
trg.stun = Math.max(trg.stun || 0, 1);
UI.popBack('u-' + trg.id, false, '🤢 СЛЁЗЫ (ПРОМАХ)', 'float-skill');
}
UI.renderBattle();
await UI.wait(2200);
}
const origEnter = UI.enterBattle.bind(UI);
UI.enterBattle = async function() {
origEnter();
const st = CORE.state;
const am = st && st.player && DATA.SHAME_AMULETS[st.player.archKey];
if (am) this.log(`🧿 Амулет в слоте: <b>${am.n}</b> (шанс 25%)`);
if (st) {
st.busy = true;
this.renderBattle();
await tryFireBsimAmulet('start');
st.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
}
};
const origActAttack = UI.actAttack.bind(UI);
UI.actAttack = async function() {
const st = CORE.state;
if (!st || st.busy || st.finished) return;
st.busy = true;
this.renderBattle();
await tryFireBsimAmulet('atk');
st.busy = false;
await origActAttack();
if (CORE.state && CORE.state.player) CORE.state.player.buff = 1;
};
const origRunEnemies = UI.runEnemiesTurn.bind(UI);
UI.runEnemiesTurn = async function() {
const st = CORE.state;
const hpBefore = st && st.player ? st.player.hp : 0;
await origRunEnemies();
if (CORE.state && !CORE.state.finished) {
CORE.state.busy = true;
this.renderBattle();
if (CORE.state.player.hp < hpBefore) await tryFireBsimAmulet('hit');
await tryFireBsimAmulet('start');
CORE.state.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
}
};
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
<script>
// ============================================================================
// ПАТЧ v1.9.0-p27-bsim1: ПОДДЕРЖКА АВТО («КОРД»/РАКЕТЫ) И СТАИ В BSIM
// ============================================================================
(function(global) {
'use strict';
const UI = global.BSIM_UI;
const CORE = global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE;
if (!UI || !CORE) return;
const SUPPORT_OPTS = {
none: null,
kord: { kind: 'car', name: '🔫 Пулемёт «Корд» (10с)', maxRank: 8, durSec: 10, stun: 0 },
rockets:{ kind: 'car', name: '🚀 Ракетный комплекс (15с)', maxRank: 9, durSec: 15, stun: 2 },
fierce: { kind: 'pack', name: '🐾 Свора Бешеных Лютых (10с)', maxRank: 8, durSec: 10, stun: 0 },
titan: { kind: 'pack', name: '👹 Альфа-Титан Улья (15с)', maxRank: 9, durSec: 15, stun: 2 }
};
// Добавляем выпадающий список «Поддержка» в конструктор bsim.html
const startBtn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="BSIM_UI.enterBattle()"]');
if (startBtn && startBtn.parentNode && !document.getElementById('sim-support')) {
const row = document.createElement('div');
row.style.marginTop = '6px';
row.innerHTML = '<label>Огневая поддержка / Сопровождение стаи</label>' +
'<select id="sim-support">' +
'<option value="none">Без поддержки</option>' +
'<option value="kord">🔫 Джип: Пулемёт «Корд» (10с • Элита и ниже)</option>' +
'<option value="rockets">🚀 Грузовик: Ракетный комплекс (15с • Скреббер + стан 2х)</option>' +
'<option value="fierce">🐾 Стая: Свора Бешеных Лютых (10с • мяу/шмяк)</option>' +
'<option value="titan">👹 Стая: Альфа-Титан Улья (15с • стан 2х + плюх/косяк)</option>' +
'</select>';
startBtn.parentNode.insertBefore(row, startBtn);
}
UI.playSupportSfx = function(isPack, isHeavy) {
const AUD = global.BSIM_AUDIO;
const c = AUD && AUD.ensureCtx();
const shouts = ['🐱 МЯУ-РРР!', '💦 ШМЯК!', '🫧 ПЛЮХ!', '🤪 КОСЯК!'];
const shout = shouts[Math.floor(Math.random() * shouts.length)];
if (!c) return shout;
const now = c.currentTime, o = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain();
if (isPack) {
o.type = shout.includes('МЯУ') ? 'triangle' : 'sawtooth';
o.frequency.setValueAtTime(shout.includes('МЯУ') ? 340 : 190, now);
o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(shout.includes('МЯУ') ? 620 : 45, now + 0.25);
} else {
o.type = 'sawtooth';
o.frequency.setValueAtTime(isHeavy ? 130 : 280, now);
o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(38, now + (isHeavy ? 0.35 : 0.14));
}
g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.36);
o.connect(g); g.connect(c.destination); o.start(now); o.stop(now + 0.37);
return shout;
};
UI.runSupportStrikeAnim = function(sup, enemies) {
return new Promise(resolve => {
const isPack = sup.kind === 'pack', isHeavy = sup.durSec >= 15;
const totalMs = sup.durSec * 1000, stepMs = 650, ticks = Math.floor(totalMs / stepMs);
const ov = document.createElement('div');
ov.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,4,8,0.95);z-index:9990;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:12px;font-family:monospace;color:#fff;';
ov.innerHTML = `<div style="width:100%;max-width:400px;background:#191018;border:2px solid #ef4444;border-radius:10px;padding:14px;text-align:center;">` +
`<div style="color:#fde047;font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;">${sup.name}</div>` +
`<div id="bsim-sup-shout" style="font-size:20px;color:#ff8a8a;margin:12px 0;font-weight:bold;">${isPack ? '🐱 МЯУ-РРР!' : '💥 ОГОНЬ!'}</div>` +
`<div style="width:100%;height:8px;background:#291518;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;"><div id="bsim-sup-bar" style="width:0%;height:100%;background:#ef4444;"></div></div></div>`;
document.body.appendChild(ov);
let t = 0;
const tm = setInterval(() => {
t++;
const shout = UI.playSupportSfx(isPack, isHeavy);
const sEl = document.getElementById('bsim-sup-shout'), bEl = document.getElementById('bsim-sup-bar');
if (sEl) sEl.textContent = isPack ? shout : (isHeavy ? `🚀 ЗАЛП #${t}/${ticks}!` : `🔥 ОЧЕРЕДЬ #${t}/${ticks}!`);
if (bEl) bEl.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.round((t / ticks) * 100)) + '%';
if (t >= ticks) {
clearInterval(tm);
const alive = enemies.filter(e => !e.dead && Number(e.rank || 0) <= sup.maxRank);
let killed = 0, damaged = 0;
if (alive.length > 0) {
if (Math.random() < 0.50) {
const trg = alive.slice().sort((a, b) => Number(b.rank || 0) - Number(a.rank || 0))[0];
trg.hp = CORE.state.mode === 'game' ? 0 : 1;
if (CORE.state.mode === 'game') trg.dead = true;
killed = 1;
} else {
alive.forEach(en => {
const cut = Math.max(1, Math.round((en.maxHp || en.hp || 50) * 0.30));
en.hp = Math.max(1, (en.hp || 10) - cut);
damaged++;
});
}
}
if (sup.stun > 0) enemies.filter(e => !e.dead).forEach(en => { en.stun = Math.max(en.stun || 0, sup.stun); });
setTimeout(() => { if (ov.parentNode) ov.remove(); resolve({ killed, damaged, stun: sup.stun }); }, 350);
}
}, stepMs);
});
};
global.BSIM_SUPPORT_OPTS = SUPPORT_OPTS;
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
<script>
// ============================================================================
// ПАТЧ v1.9.0-p27-bsim2: КНОПКА ПОДДЕРЖКИ В БОЮ И СРАБАТЫВАНИЕ ПЕРЕД ХОДОМ
// ============================================================================
(function(global) {
'use strict';
const UI = global.BSIM_UI;
const CORE = global.STIKS_COMBAT_CORE;
if (!UI || !CORE) return;
const origEnter = UI.enterBattle.bind(UI);
UI.enterBattle = async function() {
await origEnter();
const selKey = (document.getElementById('sim-support') || {}).value || 'none';
const sup = global.BSIM_SUPPORT_OPTS && global.BSIM_SUPPORT_OPTS[selKey];
if (CORE.state && sup) {
CORE.state.supportCfg = Object.assign({}, sup);
CORE.state.supportUsed = false;
CORE.state.supportQueued = false;
this.renderBattle();
}
};
UI.callSimSupport = async function() {
const st = CORE.state;
if (!st || st.busy || st.finished || !st.supportCfg || st.supportUsed) return;
st.supportUsed = true;
st.supportQueued = true;
st.busy = true;
this.log(`📡 <b>${st.player.name}</b> запрашивает: <b>${st.supportCfg.name}</b>! Атака пропущена, удар накроет врагов перед следующим ходом.`);
this.renderBattle();
await this.runEnemiesTurn();
};
const origActAttack = UI.actAttack.bind(UI);
UI.actAttack = async function() {
const st = CORE.state;
if (st && st.supportQueued && st.supportCfg && !st.finished) {
st.supportQueued = false;
st.busy = true;
this.renderBattle();
const res = await this.runSupportStrikeAnim(st.supportCfg, st.enemies);
this.log(`💥 <b>[${st.supportCfg.name}]</b>: убито ${res.killed}, ранено (-30% ОЗ) ${res.damaged}${res.stun ? ', оглушение на 2 хода!' : '!'}`);
st.busy = false;
this.renderBattle();
if (this.checkBattleEnd()) return;
}
await origActAttack();
};
const origRenderBattle = UI.renderBattle.bind(UI);
UI.renderBattle = function() {
origRenderBattle();
const st = CORE.state;
const abBox = document.getElementById('battle-abilities');
if (!st || !st.supportCfg || !abBox || document.getElementById('btn-bsim-support')) return;
const btn = document.createElement('button');
btn.id = 'btn-bsim-support';
btn.className = 'btn btn-primary';
btn.disabled = Boolean(st.busy || st.finished || st.supportUsed);
btn.textContent = st.supportUsed
? `${st.supportCfg.name} — Использовано`
: `📡 Вызвать: ${st.supportCfg.name} (пропуск атаки → удар перед след. ходом)`;
btn.onclick = () => UI.callSimSupport();
abBox.appendChild(btn);
};
})(typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : globalThis);
</script>
